<div class="card-body">
'''Presence Of The Force''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フォースの顕現</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意のロケーションカード上に配備し、</span> [Dark Force icon] <span lang="ja">と</span> [Light Force icon] <span lang="ja">を１つずつ加える。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-227o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">土地は、そこに刻まれた歴史によって様々な相を見せる。かくてフォースは、「…銀河を一つにまとめ」満ちて、また引く。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Manifestation of the Force.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on any location card and add one Dark Force icon and one Light Force icon.

'''Lore:''' Places take on different aspects according to the history etched into them. Thus the Force, which “binds the galaxy together,” ebbs and flows.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Presence Of The Force]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 99. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
